entities.title: Docking
entities.summary: When the station's slot is reached, the four docking checks, the auto-dock and docking itself.
entities.purpose: Says when the docking box is reached and whether the approach passes (RULES B.12.1, B.12.2), runs the auto-dock (B.12.3), and docks: the countdown cancelled and the docked state entered (B.12.4, D.3.11).
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
What a failed docking does to the player is the combat capability's (failed_docking).
